task_text: IKEA MuJoCo STEGESUND roll stand (IKEA STEGESUND toilet roll stand (AA-2652783-1), manual steps 1-3) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Build the STEGESUND roll stand: press half B onto half A at the two leg crossings, push the shelf in from the foot end, drive the four bolts through the legs into the shelf's rail ends with the hex key, stand the frame up and drop the top rod into the two crotches. Success requirements: Every part except half A and the hex key is at its assembled pose relative to half A (a bolt: relative to the shelf): half B and the shelf within 0.6 mm and 1 degree; the top rod within 3 mm and 1 degree (up to the rod's own symmetry: it may lie end for end, or turned by a facet); each bolt within 0.6 mm along and across its bore axis, its axis within 2 degrees (spin free). The stand is upright: half A's z axis within 1 degree of world +z. success.py checks only the end state, and the hex key may be anywhere at the end; the terminal rules below add the release, rest and no-breakdown checks. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: Each bolt's coarse right-hand thread (2.5 mm pitch) is a capsule helix against a matching helix in the shelf's rail end: a bolt advances only by being turned, by the hex key in its 4 mm socket. The half-lap crossings are press fits (contact and friction, no weld). A bolt's seat weld is armed at its first thread contact; once its head touches and it has stopped relative to the shelf for 0.05 s, the bolt and the half it clamps are welded to the shelf at their current pose, and the bolt and its rail-end thread stop colliding.
